bottom_line: Family-owned (Davis family), single US factory Le Sueur MN. 93% quartz content. Highest manufacturing consistency — no multi-source variance. GREENGUARD Gold certified. Chipping class-action was pre-2020 formula. Fabricator consensus: best engineered quartz for consistency and quality. NSF 51 food contact certified.
